ui.settings.page.title.note: The Settings page's own title. Short; it sits beside a gear icon.

ui.settings.profile.description_anonymou.note: Same opening as the authenticated variant minus the account sentence; the two must not diverge in wording for the shared part.

ui.settings.profile.description_authenti.note: Reads as one paragraph. Second sentence says the details come from the Radient account.

ui.settings.profile.display_name.label.note: A short field label above an input.

ui.settings.profile.display_name.placeho.note: Shown in an empty text input; ends with an ellipsis.

ui.settings.profile.email.label.note: A short field label above an input.

ui.settings.profile.email.placeholder.note: Shown in an empty text input; ends with an ellipsis.

ui.settings.profile.title.note: Names the section holding display name and email.

ui.settings.section.interface_language.h.note: Says the setting is shared with the terminal and that 'auto' follows the OS, falling back to English. The literal token `auto` names a picker option and must stay untranslated.

ui.settings.section.interface_language.l.note: Must contain the word for 'language' so the settings search finds it; scoped to the whole app.

ui.settings.tour.action.note: Starts the onboarding tour. Sits beside a play-in-circle icon.

ui.settings.tour.description.note: Asks whether the reader missed or wants a refresher, then says to start it here.

ui.settings.tour.title.note: Names the section that restarts the onboarding tour.

ui.settings.profile.account_checking.role: profile section status line while the account read is in flight
ui.settings.profile.account_checking.tone: plain present-progressive sentence, ends with an ellipsis
ui.settings.profile.account_checking.note: Shown above the name/email fields so placeholder defaults are not read as the user's own details.

ui.settings.profile.account_read_failed_.role: profile section warning when the account read failed (generic failure)
ui.settings.profile.account_read_failed_.tone: two plain sentences; second is a short imperative
ui.settings.profile.account_read_failed_.note: Whole-sentence variant: the trailing instruction differs by failure class, so it is part of the message, not a concatenated suffix.

ui.settings.profile.account_read_failed_.role: profile section warning when the backend refused the Radient credential
ui.settings.profile.account_read_failed_.tone: two plain sentences; second offers retry or signing in again
ui.settings.profile.account_read_failed_.note: Whole-sentence variant used only when the backend named radient_credential_refused; must match the retry variant except for the closing instruction.

ui.settings.profile.retry.role: button label in the account-read warning

ui.settings.profile.retrying.role: button label while that re-read is running
ui.settings.profile.retrying.note: Disabled state of the Retry button after the reader's own press.

ui.settings.section.delegated_enabled.ga.length: One toast, status line, settings row, or hub update sentence; keep compact.

ui.settings.section.delegated_enabled.he.length: One toast, status line, settings row, or hub update sentence; keep compact.
ui.settings.section.delegated_enabled.he.note: English source: Applies to subagent runs, agent shells and background runs only.

ui.settings.section.delegated_enabled.la.length: One toast, status line, settings row, or hub update sentence; keep compact.
ui.settings.section.delegated_enabled.la.note: English source: Remove delegated sessions automatically

ui.settings.section.delegated_max_age.he.length: One toast, status line, settings row, or hub update sentence; keep compact.
ui.settings.section.delegated_max_age.he.note: English source: The retention window: how long a delegated session (a subagent or background run) can sit idle before it is removed.

ui.settings.section.delegated_max_age.la.length: One toast, status line, settings row, or hub update sentence; keep compact.

ui.settings.section.session_delegated.ti.length: One toast, status line, settings row, or hub update sentence; keep compact.
ui.settings.section.session_delegated.ti.note: English source: Delegated work: subagents and background sessions

ui.settings.personal_profile.heading.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.heading.note: Personal cloud profile, distinct from local operator identity and agent profiles.

ui.settings.personal_profile.display_nam.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.display_nam.note: Human account presentation name; 64 Unicode code points. Empty clears to identity-name fallback.

ui.settings.personal_profile.title.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.title.note: Personal job/title field, not the section heading; at most 80 Unicode code points.

ui.settings.personal_profile.description.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.description.note: Personal biography, at most 500 Unicode code points and 8 lines; not agent instructions.

ui.settings.personal_profile.timezone.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.timezone.note: IANA timezone selection; no free text. Used for the person’s local time in profile cards.

ui.settings.personal_profile.timezone_pl.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.timezone_pl.note: Search the IANA zone options; typing is not a custom zone submission.

ui.settings.personal_profile.timezone_cl.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.timezone_cl.note: Explicitly clears the optional timezone rather than changing it to the current device timezone.

ui.settings.personal_profile.loading.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.loading.note: Cloud profile read unresolved. Must never be presented as an empty successful editor.

ui.settings.personal_profile.load_error.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.load_error.note: Cloud profile read failed; retry stays beside the explanation. No editable empty fallback.

ui.settings.personal_profile.save.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.save.note: Saves dirty text fields only; photo is a separate transaction.

ui.settings.personal_profile.saving.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.saving.note: In-flight text or photo save; terse status. Controls remain in place and framing is frozen.

ui.settings.personal_profile.saved.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.saved.note: Text save completed under the same captured account/view authority.

ui.settings.personal_profile.save_error.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.save_error.note: Text write failed; unsaved draft is retained and no success is claimed.

ui.settings.personal_profile.choose.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.choose.note: Choose a local PNG/JPEG/WebP file; does not upload until explicit Save photo.

ui.settings.personal_profile.replace.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.replace.note: Choose a different photo, retaining the current cloud photo until successful explicit save.

ui.settings.personal_profile.photo_help.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.photo_help.note: Shown under the photo controls before a file is picked: accepted formats and the 1 MiB byte limit only. The pixel limits moved to photo_invalid so the help stays short. Preserve the MiB unit.

ui.settings.personal_profile.remove.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.remove.note: Opens explicit slot-removal confirmation. Never removes a photo automatically.

ui.settings.personal_profile.remove_uplo.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.remove_uplo.note: Removing uploaded slot may reveal saved provider sign-in photo, otherwise initials; does not promise deleting both slots.

ui.settings.personal_profile.remove_prov.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.remove_prov.note: Removing provider sign-in slot may reveal an existing upload, otherwise initials. Must preserve conditional consequence.

ui.settings.personal_profile.photo_error.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.photo_error.note: Failure to save/remove photo; unrelated text draft remains intact.

ui.settings.personal_profile.photo_inval.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.photo_inval.note: Shown beside the photo controls when the picked file is not a usable image. States every fixed service limit: PNG/JPEG/WebP, 1 MiB bytes, maximum 4096 pixels per edge, 16000000 pixels in total. Preserve numeric meaning and unit.

ui.settings.personal_profile.photo_saved.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.photo_saved.note: Explicit photo upload completed; not merely selection or canvas encoding.

ui.settings.personal_profile.photo_remov.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.photo_remov.note: Explicit requested avatar slot removal completed; another saved slot may remain visible.

ui.settings.personal_profile.crop_area.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.crop_area.note: Focusable human photo crop group; arrow keys pan and keyboard zoom works.

ui.settings.personal_profile.crop_instru.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.crop_instru.note: Drag/arrows pan, plus/minus zoom, zero recenters. {width} and {height} are source pixel dimensions; preserve placeholders and key tokens.

ui.settings.personal_profile.zoom.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.zoom.note: Photo crop magnification, not app-window zoom.

ui.settings.personal_profile.zoom_in.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.zoom_in.note: Increases crop magnification; preserves the current focal point.

ui.settings.personal_profile.zoom_out.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.zoom_out.note: Decreases crop magnification within the cropper bounds.

ui.settings.personal_profile.zoom_value.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.zoom_value.note: {value} is a formatted magnification factor such as 1.25. Keep its placeholder and multiplication sign.

ui.settings.personal_profile.recenter.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.recenter.note: Moves the photo back to centered framing; not removal/reset of text profile.

ui.settings.personal_profile.previews.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.previews.note: The live preview is the same crop that will be saved.

ui.settings.personal_profile.preview.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.preview.note: Human profile photo preview, not an agent avatar.

ui.settings.personal_profile.preview_cap.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.preview_cap.note: Compact caption under the human circular photo preview.

ui.settings.personal_profile.save_photo.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.save_photo.note: Explicitly encodes/uploads the selected human crop; separate from Save profile.

ui.settings.personal_profile.crop_error.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.crop_error.note: Canvas could not prepare photo bytes; no cloud upload has started.

ui.settings.personal_profile.manage.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.manage.note: Only explicit user click opens canonical account console for email, identity and sign-in/password administration. Native fields never edit these.

ui.settings.personal_profile.discard.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.discard.note: Question before explicit Cancel discards unsaved text. Navigation instead retains text in memory; cancelling crop does not discard text.

ui.settings.personal_profile.discard_act.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.discard_act.note: Confirms discarding unsaved text and clears its memory-only retained draft.

ui.settings.personal_profile.keep_editin.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.keep_editin.note: Dismisses text-discard confirmation and retains current draft.

ui.settings.personal_profile.edit.tone: Concise, professional sentence case; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.edit.note: Only independently resolved active human self gets this action. Closes card, navigates to native Settings and transfers focus.

ui.settings.personal_profile.description.tone: One short imperative sentence; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.description.note: Shown under the About you field when the draft has too many lines. {count} is the maximum number of lines (currently 8). The field label is already above it.

ui.settings.personal_profile.field_too_l.tone: One short imperative sentence; follow the locale style guide.
ui.settings.personal_profile.field_too_l.note: Shown under ONE profile text field (display name 64, title 80, About you 500) when its draft is too long for the service. {count} is that field's limit in characters (Unicode code points). The field label is already above it, so do not repeat the field name.
